etymology_chain.definition: to be bleary- or watery-eyed, to have reduced sight

definitions.text_en: to dazzle (blind temporarily through excessive light)
definitions.text_mt: Iċaħħan il-vista temporanjament minħabba dawl qawwi

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xemx tgħammex l-għajnejn jekk tħares lejha direttament.
usage_examples.en: The sun dazzles the eyes if you look directly at it.

usage_examples.mt: Id-dawl tal-karozza għammxu għal mument meta għadda.
usage_examples.en: The car light dazzled him for a moment as it passed.

usage_examples.mt: Ġwanni Battista kien l-għammied li għammed lil Ġesù.
usage_examples.en: John the Baptist was the baptist who baptised Jesus.

usage_examples.mt: L-għammied libes libsa bajda għaċ-ċerimonja tal-magħmudija.
usage_examples.en: The baptist wore a white robe for the baptism ceremony.

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-bir x'aktarx li hu għammieq ħafna.
usage_examples.en: This well is likely to be very deep.

usage_examples.mt: L-imħabba tagħha lejh kienet għammieqa u sinċiera.
usage_examples.en: Her love for him was deep and sincere.

usage_examples.mt: Ixtraw għamra ġdida għall-kamra tas-sodda qabel ma marru jgħixu hemmhekk.
usage_examples.en: They bought new furnishings for the bedroom before they went to live there.

usage_examples.mt: L-għamra kollha tad-dar intilfet fin-nar li qered kollox.
usage_examples.en: All the house furnishings were lost in the fire that destroyed everything.

usage_examples.mt: Il-knisja l-qadima għandha sitt għewiemed kbar tal-irħam.
usage_examples.en: The old church has six large marble columns.

usage_examples.mt: Kull għamud kien imżeijen b'tinqix mill-isbaħ.
usage_examples.en: Each column was adorned with the most beautiful carvings.

definitions.text_mt: Għeluq u ftuħ malajr ta' għajn

usage_examples.mt: Tana għamża u tbissem qabel ma telaq.
usage_examples.en: He gave her a wink and smiled before he left.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-ikel, ta għamża qasira fuq is-sufan.
usage_examples.en: After eating, he took a short nap on the sofa.

usage_examples.mt: X'inhu l-għan ewlieni ta' dan il-proġett?
usage_examples.en: What is the main purpose of this project?

usage_examples.mt: L-għan tiegħu fil-ħajja hu li jsir tabib u jgħin lin-nies.
usage_examples.en: His goal in life is to become a doctor and help people.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġid u l-għana ma jġibux il-kuntentizza jekk m'hemmx saħħa.
usage_examples.en: Wealth and riches do not bring happiness if there is no health.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għana tal-belt tkejjel bil-fabbriki u n-negozji li fiha.
usage_examples.en: The richness of the city is measured by the factories and businesses in it.

usage_examples.mt: Smajna l-għana fil-festa tar-raħal u għoġobna ħafna.
usage_examples.en: We heard the Maltese folk music at the village feast and liked it very much.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kummerċ mal-barranin għana lill-belt kollha u għamilha magħrufa.
usage_examples.en: Trade with foreigners enriched the whole city and made it famous.

usage_examples.mt: L-edukazzjoni tgħana l-ħajja tan-nies u tiftaħilhom bibien ġodda.
usage_examples.en: Education enriches people's lives and opens new doors for them.

definitions.text_en: plum as a mass, taste, species)
definitions.text_mt: Togħma u speċi ta' din il-frotta

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xitwa waslet u l-għanbaqar fis-siġra sar ħelu u misjur.
usage_examples.en: Winter came and the plums on the tree became sweet and ripe.

usage_examples.mt: Pjantaħt siġra tal-għanbaqar fil-ġnien warajna.
usage_examples.en: I planted a plum tree in the back garden.

definitions.text_mt: Reżina fossili ta' lewn isfar jew oranġjo

usage_examples.mt: L-għanbar jintuża b'mod wiesa' fil-ġojjellerija u fl-arti.
usage_examples.en: Amber is widely used in jewellery and in art.

usage_examples.mt: Sibna biċċa għanbar fuq il-bajja wara l-maltemp.
usage_examples.en: We found a piece of amber on the beach after the storm.

usage_examples.mt: Mur għand it-tabib għax ma tiflaħx u għandek deni.
usage_examples.en: Go to the doctor because you are unwell and have a fever.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ktieb il-ġdid jinsab għand l-għalliem fuq l-iskrivanija.
usage_examples.en: The new book is with the teacher on the desk.

usage_examples.mt: Illum sejrin għand in-nanna għall-ikel ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: Today we are going to grandmother's for lunch.

definitions.text_en: third-person feminine singular pronominal form of għand: at her / it, to her / it she / it has
definitions.text_mt: Forma pronominali femminili tat-tielet persuna singular tal-preposizzjoni għand

usage_examples.mt: Għandha tlett itfal u tħobbhom ħafna.
usage_examples.en: She has three children and loves them very much.

usage_examples.mt: Il-borża bl-ikel hi għandha fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: The bag with the food is with her on the table.

definitions.text_en: third-person masculine singular pronominal form of għand: at him / it, to him / it he / it has
definitions.text_mt: Forma pronominali maskili tat-tielet persuna singular tal-preposizzjoni għand

usage_examples.mt: Għandu dar kbira ħdejn il-baħar b'veduta sabiħa.
usage_examples.en: He has a big house near the sea with a beautiful view.

usage_examples.mt: Il-flus kollha miġbura huma għandu fis-sarku.
usage_examples.en: All the collected money is with him in his safe.

definitions.text_mt: Raġel li jħobb jilbes b'mod eleganti u juri d-dehra tiegħu

usage_examples.mt: Pietru huwa għandur dejjem liebes pulit u mdendel.
usage_examples.en: Peter is a dandy always dressed smartly and fashionably.

usage_examples.mt: L-għandur qatta' siegħa shiħa quddiem il-mera qabel ma ħareġ.
usage_examples.en: The dandy spent a whole hour in front of the mirror before going out.

definitions.text_en: female equivalent of għandur: a female dandy
definitions.text_mt: Mara li tħobb tilbes b'mod eleganti u turi d-dehra tagħha

usage_examples.mt: Marija saret għandura u daret il-belt kollha b'libsa ġdida.
usage_examples.en: Mary became a dandy and paraded the whole city in a new dress.

usage_examples.mt: L-għandura libset l-isbaħ libsa għall-festa tar-raħal.
usage_examples.en: The female dandy wore the most beautiful dress for the village feast.

definitions.text_en: livestock, cattle (in the broader sense), especially sheep
definitions.text_mt: Nagħaġ u mogħoż u baqar flimkien

usage_examples.mt: Ir-raħħal għandu eluf ta' nagħaġ fl-għanem tiegħu mifrux fl-għelieqi.
usage_examples.en: The farmer has thousands of sheep in his livestock spread across the fields.

usage_examples.mt: L-għanem kollu nfirex fl-għalqa wara li nfetaħ il-bieb.
usage_examples.en: All the livestock spread out across the field after the gate was opened.

definitions.text_en: a rich man, a wealthy person

usage_examples.mt: Hu raġel għani ħafna li wiret il-ġid mingħand missieru.
usage_examples.en: He is a very rich man who inherited the wealth from his father.

usage_examples.mt: L-għonja tal-belt jgħixu fil-kastell fuq l-għolja.
usage_examples.en: The rich people of the city live in the castle on the hill.

definitions.text_en: a young goat (at roughly one year of age)

usage_examples.mt: L-għaniqa tiġri warrietha fl-għalqa bla ma tieqaf.
usage_examples.en: The young goat runs after its mother in the field without stopping.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi għandu ħames għenieqi u għadd ta' mogħoż kbar.
usage_examples.en: The farmer has five young goats and a number of adult goats.

usage_examples.mt: Dik il-mara hi għanja ħafna u għandha ħafna propjetà.
usage_examples.en: That woman is very wealthy and owns a lot of property.

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja għanja kienet tbigħ l-art u tixtri aktar.
usage_examples.en: The wealthy family used to sell land and buy more.

usage_examples.mt: Kantawlna għanja sabiħa waqt iċ-ċerimonja taż-żwieġ.
usage_examples.en: They sang us a beautiful song during the wedding ceremony.

usage_examples.mt: Din hija l-għanja favorita tiegħi minn mindu kont żgħir.
usage_examples.en: This is my favourite song since I was little.

definitions.text_en: Canticles, Song of Songs, Song of Solomon
definitions.text_mt: Ktieb tal-Bibbja attribwit lil Salamun li fih poeżiji ta' mħabba

usage_examples.mt: L-Għanja tal-Għanjiet tinstab fil-Bibbja fost il-kotba poetiċi.
usage_examples.en: The Song of Songs is found in the Bible among the poetic books.

usage_examples.mt: Ħafna kompożituri bbżataw il-mużika tagħhom fuq l-Għanja tal-Għanjiet.
usage_examples.en: Many composers based their music on the Song of Songs.

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib qallu li l-għankra kienet sinjal ta' problema fit-tirojde.
usage_examples.en: The doctor told him that the goitre was a sign of a thyroid problem.

usage_examples.mt: Bix-xjuħija, bdiet tidher għankra taħt xedaqu u ma għoġbitu xejn.
usage_examples.en: With old age, a double chin started appearing under his jaw and he did not like it at all.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħbieb għannu l-kanzunetti kollha li kienu jafu b'lejl il-ħamis.
usage_examples.en: The friends sang all the songs they knew on Thursday night.

usage_examples.mt: L-għasafar jgħannu bil-ferħ filgħodu kmieni mal-ftuħ tax-xemx.
usage_examples.en: The birds sing joyfully early in the morning at sunrise.

usage_examples.mt: Ommu għannqitu sewwa qabel ma telaq għall-ivvjaġġar twil.
usage_examples.en: His mother hugged him tightly before he left for the long journey.

usage_examples.mt: Min iħobb bil-veru, jgħannaq spiss u juri l-imħabba tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: Those who truly love, hug often and show their love.
